_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Saturday, March 28th, 2026 - Good Morning Skiers and Riders! This is Laurie with your snow report from 5am for Saturday, March 28th. Remember, the easiest way to get up to date information is on the Ikon Pass app or website.  

Our Mid mountain base is 16 inches, the temperature is 47 degrees, the winds are 11 miles per hour from the SW, with clear skies. 

The Summit base is 40 inches, the temperature is 39 degrees, the winds are 19 miles per hour from the SSW, with clear skies. 

The base temperature is 28 degrees.  

We will be skiing and riding on 11 lifts, 34 runs, and 456 acres on SP snow.  


Celebrate spring at Steamboat with the Bud Light Rocks the Boat Concert Series today in Steamboat Square. Head up at 3:30 for a free live concert featuring Sneezy, bringing their high-energy blend of funk, indie rock, and feel-good jams to the stage. It’s the ultimate après scene with live music, mountain views, and a crowd ready to keep the day going. Get the details now at steamboat.com/events. 

Stay in the know with the Ikon Pass App. Find it in the app store on your mobile device and get lift and trail statuses, conditions updates, and more.  

If you are thinking of exploring outside the ski area boundaries, and don’t know exactly where you are going, don’t go.  

Ski and Ride with Care and we will see you on the mountain!
